project_type: TypeScript pnpm monorepo - AI gateway (OpenClaw) with plugin extensions
build_system: pnpm workspace with tsdown bundler; extensions are workspace packages under extensions/*
test_framework: vitest with colocated *.test.ts files; e2e tests use *.e2e.test.ts; live tests gated by OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to confirm workspace resolves. 2. Run pnpm test extensions/gpu-broker to run unit tests. 3. Confirm no type errors with pnpm build or targeted typecheck.
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install (hoisted node_modules). 2. Node 22.19+. 3. pnpm build for full build.
environment_constraints: Network available (COMMON_DEPENDENCIES). No GPU/Ollama in sandbox - GPU-gated tests must skip-with-reason. No pnpm check or full suite - use targeted tests only.
contribution_requirements: TS ESM strict. No @ts-nocheck. Use zod/typebox for schemas. Prefer defineToolPlugin for tool plugins. Extensions must not use raw registerHook - use api.on() typed hook API instead. Plugin production code must not import from other extensions or core src/**. Extensions use openclaw/plugin-sdk/* imports. Bundled plugin boundary invariants enforced. American English.
key_patterns: Tool plugins use defineToolPlugin() from openclaw/plugin-sdk/tool-plugin with TypeBox schemas. Service plugins use definePluginEntry() with api.registerService(). Manifest is openclaw.plugin.json. Package.json has openclaw.extensions field pointing to entry. tsconfig extends ../tsconfig.package-boundary.base.json. Typed hooks use api.on('hook_name', handler). Tests use vitest with vi.fn() mocks.
directory_structure: Root: src/ (core), extensions/ (plugins), packages/ (shared libs), ui/ (control UI), test/ (test infra), docs/, scripts/. Each extension is a self-contained workspace package with index.ts entry, openclaw.plugin.json manifest, package.json, tsconfig.json.
